composition_subtypes.role: Sort start and end events of train conflicts to enable sweep
Sweep through sorted events with two pointers tracking active conflicts

payload.core_composition_summary: The solution sorts start and end times of train conflict intervals, then uses a two-pointer sweep to efficiently find the time with minimum ongoing conflicts.
payload.rationale: The algorithm first prepares and sorts events (O(n log n)), then employs a two-pointer scan that moves each pointer at most n times (amortized O(n)).
